scenario.name: partial_payment
scenario.persona: Rohan, the borrower, speaks English, calm but short of money this month. Not in hardship: he can pay, just not all at once.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify when asked. After hearing the amount, ask if you can pay half now and the other half on the 15th of November. Push once more for a "yes, that's fine" if the agent hedges. Finally agree to pay the full amount by the 15th of November if the agent cannot accept a split.

turns.text: Hello, I'm an AI assistant calling from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Kiran?
Yes, this is Kiran speaking. How can I help you?

Hi Kiran, I'm calling from Lumen Finance about an important matter on your account. Before we discuss anything, I need to verify your identity. Could you share the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Thank you, Kiran. Your home improvement loan EMI of twenty five thousand rupees is due on the twenty fifth of October, and it is now nine days overdue. A charge of five hundred rupees has been added as per your loan terms. Can you clear this today? I can send you a secure payment link by SMS or WhatsApp.
I understand, but this month is a bit tight for me. Can I pay half today, around twelve thousand seven fifty, and the rest by the fifteenth of November?

One moment, let me check the details for you. You can pay any amount through the link, and it will go toward your EMI. But since the full amount won't be paid by the due date, the late charge will still apply. Would you like me to send the payment link so you can pay the part amount today?
So you're saying yes, that's fine, I pay half now and the remaining twelve five on the fifteenth, right? The late charge I can accept if that's how it works.
Okay. I've sent the payment link to your registered mobile number via SMS. Please complete the part payment when you can. Is there anything else you need help with today?
Just to confirm, the remaining twelve thousand five hundred by the fifteenth of November is okay, right?
Yes, that is noted. You will pay the remaining twelve thousand five hundred rupees by the fifteenth of November. Thank you for confirming, Kiran. Thank you for your time, have a good day.

result.status: This EMI is overdue by nine days. Ask whether they can clear it today and offer the payment link.

result.policy: Any amount can be paid through the payment link. It goes first to the EMI due. If the full EMI is not paid by the due date, the late payment charge still applies once. The remaining amount can be paid later through the same link.
result.message: Answer only what they asked, in one or two short sentences, from this text. Never add an amount, date or rule that is not in it.

args.notes: Borrower agreed to pay half amount today and remaining twelve thousand seven hundred and fifty rupees by the fifteenth of November. Accepted late fee.

outcome.notes: Borrower agreed to pay half amount today and remaining twelve thousand seven hundred and fifty rupees by the fifteenth of November. Accepted late fee.
